name: 1. Formation of LLC
text: 1. The undersigned parties agree to form a Maine limited liability company (“LLC”), to be called Dialogo, with membership interests owned initially as follows: 49% by Lilhan Santiago Bauza (“LSB”), a Massachusetts resident, and 51% by Direct Merchants S.A., Inc (“DMSA”), a New Jersey Corporation, for the purpose of jointly developing Spanish language and bilingual print and media business (‘‘the Business”).

name: 1. Board management
text: The LLC will be managed by a board of directors, consisting of two representatives from DMSA and one from LSB.

name: 1. Publisher title
text: Lillian Santiago Bauza will carry the title of Publisher.

name: 1. Publisher responsibilities
text: She will be responsible for editonial content and for managing the day-to-day operations of the venture, including recruiting and hiring employees and contractors and, along with DMSA management, developing the long-term strategy of the joint venture.

name: 1. No LSB cash contribution
text: DMSA acknowledges that LSB will not contribute any cash to initiate the LLC.

name: 1. Expenditure concurrence
text: LSB acknowledges all expenditures must be done with the concurrence of DMSA.

name: 1. Initial capital contribution
text: DMSA shall contribute the initial capital to launch the LLC in an amount that DMSA deems appropriate (including through travel, promotional costs, legal fees, accounting fees, billing fees and the labor of management and staff of DMSA).

name: 1. Transfer and issuance agreement
text: The owners will sign an agreement giving each other a right of first refusal on any proposed transfer of membership interests in the LLC and requiring approval by the Board of Directors issuing any additional membership interests.

name: 1. Distribution of profits
text: All profits that the board decides to distribute, both ordinary and capital, will be distributed to the members in proportion to their membership interest.

name: 1. Tax distributions
text: The board shall distribute each year at least enough cash to owners to cover the owners’ U.S. tax liability for LLC profits in such year if any.

name: 2. Joint pursuit of Business
text: 2. DMSA and LSB agree that they shall through the LLC jointly pursue the Business.

name: 2. DMSA outside interests
text: LSB acknowledges and agrees, however, that DMSA ts an on- going enterprise, and its principals individually and through other enterprises, have a variety of business interests that are not and will not be part of the LLC’s business, whether similar to the LLC’s Business or not.

name: 2. No obligation to provide business
text: LSB further acknowledges and agrees that neither DMSA nor its principals shall have any obligation to assign existing, or originate new business, advertising contracts, marketing contracts, or any other contracts for the benefit of the LLC, or to assign existing or originate new advertising opportunities or clients for the benefit of the LLC,

name: 2. Retained opportunities and clients
text: DMSA and its principals may retain existing and originate new media opportunities, advertising contracts and clients for its own benefit, whether directly or indirectly.

name: 2. DMSA diligent efforts
text: Without diminishing DMSA’s rights under the foregoing language, DMSA does agree that it intends to use diligent efforts to direct appropriate business to the Company in furtherance of the Company’s goals.

name: 2. LSB diligent efforts
text: However, LSB shall employ diligent efforts to originate new media and advertising contracts and clients for the LLC

name: 2. LSB noncompetition
text: neither LSB nor its principals shall provide such services, directly or indirectly for itself or any other entity or person to the extent it relates to the Business.

name: 3. Initial staffing reliance
text: 3. The LLC will initially rely on the staffs of DMSA and Dialogo
